page_topic_one_liner: Coding Plan — China's hybrid AI developer subscription model between flat SaaS and pure token billing, with tier caps and structural contradictions
differentiator_vs_generic: This is a pricing/business-model analysis of Chinese AI coding subscriptions (¥ tiers, quota meters, aggregator API keys), NOT a product tutorial, NOT Western Claude/Cursor subscription comparison alone. Hero must show three-tier pricing cards with fixed monthly fee + usage-cap gauge — the intermediate billing model visual.
visual_anchors: HERO (~55% canvas): Three-tier Coding Plan pricing cards — Lite/Pro/Max blur labels with ¥ price blur, each card has a circular usage-cap gauge (partial fill at different levels)
Spectrum bar: Notion-style flat SaaS icon on left, DeepSeek token-meter icon on right, Coding Plan highlighted in center wedge
Secondary: API key chip flowing into IDE icons (Cursor, Cline blur silhouettes)
anti_patterns: Generic SaaS dashboard unrelated to pricing
Pure token billing receipt as sole hero
Code editor screenshot without pricing metaphor
Western-only $20/month subscription cards without ¥ tier structure
